reuse.why: Uses the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, post/getServer and BankSyncError; there is no shared link-account or download helper in the tree to reuse.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkEnableBankingAccount/linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Enable Banking download, and the fintegra starting-balance branch is identical to the akahu branch.

placement.why: Each piece sits where its siblings do: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and balance branch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the Fintegra provider wiring is added; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider style, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a second identical balance branch, so a change to linking behaviour must be repeated again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the existing shared pieces (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse); no higher-level link abstraction exists to go around.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied link, download and balance blocks are verbatim copies, not renamed or reshaped.
